title: Why is my document not in search?

hotspots.label: Did the connector upload it?
hotspots.detail: Check the posted documents in a mocked run first.

hotspots.label: Has it finished indexing?
hotspots.detail: An accepted upload is not yet a searchable document. Use glean-idx document status.

hotspots.label: Is the datasource healthy?
hotspots.detail: glean-idx datasource status shows uploaded and indexed counts per object type, identity counts, visibility, and recent runs.

hotspots.label: Can this user see it?
hotspots.detail: glean-idx document access shows whether a given user can see a document. A correct-looking ACL is wrong if its identities were never pushed.

hotspots.label: Careful commands
hotspots.detail: teardown cannot be undone. SDK exit codes are stable for scripting. An ambiguous failure is reconciled by reading state back, never by repeating the write.
